audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers handed Lucian five of seven stages and rated them 2/10, while the win rate is 56.12% over 670 games, the packet chart reads Lucian/Kled/Kled/Kled/Kled/Kled/Skill, and the page's own whys[1] through whys[5] describe Kled winning every one of those rows ('your first hard kill threat', 'out-bursts a Lucian who's spent his dash', 'Kled's peak'). diffRating also said 8.5/10 and report[14] said 'Hard matchup' while diff read FAV.
audit.why: This is the exact two-layers failure the page renders to a paying reader: a level chart saying Lucian owns Level 3 sitting next to a why-line saying Kled out-bursts him there.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 set to Kled and row 6 to Skill as matched pairs in both layers, ratings re-scaled 7/8/7/7/8/5; diffRating to 4.5/10 with tone, difficulty and final-rating prose brought in line. Level 1 left with Lucian — whys[0] and early both agree he owns it.
sources: packet levelChart and winRate 56.12 over 670 games

audit.whatIsWrong: Relentless Pursuit was described only as 'his dash + reset' with no number, and The Culling's cooldown appeared nowhere.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s — a very long dash cooldown, which is why baiting it wins the lane. Crucially, Riot's text says Lightslinger attacks reduce it, so denying him autos keeps it down. The Culling is 110/100/90s.
audit.corrected: The 16s figure and the Lightslinger cooldown-reduction written into the interactions row, the cooldown block and the first Do; The Culling's 110s added.
sources: kit file lucian E and R

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never stated the single most exploitable fact in the matchup: that Relentless Pursuit's cooldown is shortened by his own Lightslinger double-shots. It also never named the double-shot as an auto-attack reset tell.
audit.why: Lightslinger fires after every ability, so his burst always opens on an attack — the wind-up is the disengage cue, not the cast. And because those attacks refund his dash, standing in his auto range while waiting out the 16s is self-defeating.
audit.corrected: Both written into the interactions row and the cooldown block.
sources: kit file lucian P and E

notes: No mirror existed; this file defines the chart lucian__kled must invert: Lucian, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kled, Skill. The page was rendering Lucian as the winner of five stages at 2/10 each while its own prose said the opposite — the worst two-layer disagreement I found in this slice. I also brought diffRating and the final-rating line in line with the FAV label and the 56.12% win rate. Left alone deliberately: I did not add Grievous Wounds anywhere. The missing-interactions file flags Lucian as needing anti-heal via Lightslinger, but Riot's passive text only describes bonus damage when an ALLY heals or shields him — there is no self-heal in the text, so his sustain here is item lifesteal and I would be asserting a mechanic the kit does not state.
